title: feat(plugin-security): the boot writes no sys_position row — delete the built-in and declared position seeders and the everyone baseline junction writer (ADR-0131 D2, #15204 stage 6a)
body:
Part of #15204 (ADR-0131 cutover, stage 6a). This PR deletes the built-in and declared position seeders and the `everyone` baseline junction writer. The card stays open for the remaining stages.
Clause-②: no

**Size:** 36 files, +443 / −2,045 (2,488 changed lines) against `main` at `b7cd1af9df`. That is under the 3,000 line.

**Landing:** this PR stays a draft until stage 5 (C9) lands, per order correction 3 of the stage-0 record on #15204. Setup's position pickers still read rows, so on a fresh database they would list no built-in position.

## What is deleted

- `plugin-security/src/bootstrap-builtin-positions.ts` (`bootstrapBuiltinRoles`, 166 lines)
- `plugin-security/src/bootstrap-declared-positions.ts` (`bootstrapDeclaredPositions`, 391 lines), with its test file (410 lines)
- In `security-plugin.ts`:
  - the `seedCatalogPositions`, `seedCatalogBuiltins` and `bindBaselineToEveryone` closures;
  - their calls in the boot sweep and in the organization-creation hook;
  - the two imports, and the `resolveOwnOrganizationRow` / `seedCtx` imports that only they used.
  - `seedCatalogForOrganization` now runs the one catalog step left (the permission-set seeder, which 6b-2 retires).
- `isBuiltinPositionName` in `builtin-positions.ts`. Its only caller was the deleted declared-positions seeder's exclusion.

`per-organization-catalog.ts` is untouched: 6a never imported it directly, and 6c retires it. `bootstrap-platform-admin.ts` imported nothing from the deleted modules (measured: no import, two comments only), so there is no seam with 6b-2.

## Why no grant moves

Since stage 1 the resolver reads position definitions:

- `everyone`'s baseline is the anchor's declared `permissionSets`. `declareEveryoneBaseline` registers it at `kernel:ready`.
- The set list is `this.baselinePermissionSets`, which is the app's default set composed with `member_default`.
- It is filtered by `describeHighPrivilegeBits` against the same declared-capability context `bindBaselineToEveryone` used.

So the junction rows this PR stops writing granted nothing. Measured:

- `builtin-positions.boot.test.ts` boots the real plugin over SQLite in 3 postures × 4 variants, including a new **existing database** variant that holds the rows the retired seeders wrote.
  - Every principal's grant envelope equals the unchanged golden: platform admin, organization admin, member and agent, fresh and existing.
  - **Zero-write census:** no `sys_position` row and no ledger write in any variant. An existing database keeps exactly the rows it had.
  - **Positive control:** one organization-authored create reads back as exactly one row.
- `security-plugin.test.ts`: the `everyone` definition names the app set when its token is declared, and does not when the token is undeclared or names a platform capability. No junction row is written for either token.
- dogfood `declared-position-provenance`: a real showcase boot writes no position row, and a cold boot of an existing database re-stamps, refreshes and adds nothing.
- The resolver's batch-equivalence golden (`resolve-authz-context.batch-equivalence.golden.json`) is not touched.

| dogfood `position-held-name-setup-create` | the precondition expects no seeded row |

## Docs and ledgers

- Docs: `authorization.mdx` (the declared-positions bullet and the lifecycle row), `positions.mdx`, `permission-metadata.mdx`, `system-context.mdx` (rows 11b and 23b), and `tenant-audit-census.mdx`. The census is regenerated (238 → 233 write sites: the 5 deleted writes) and its prose figures are updated.
- Code comments: TSDoc that named the seeders in `builtin-positions.ts`, `reserved-identity-names.ts`, `position-catalog-refusal.ts`, `suggested-audience-bindings.ts` and `bootstrap-platform-admin.ts`.
- Ledgers: `engine-double-contract.baseline.json`, `engine-double-contract.pinned.json` and `objectql-double-limit.baseline.json` drop the doubles that went with the deleted cases.
- Not touched: `content/docs/releases/` and any `packages/spec/src` path. 6b-1c, now on `main`, already rewrote `high-privilege.ts`'s sentence naming `bindBaselineToEveryone`.

## Open question for the seat: the audience-binding suggestion confirm

_Settled: the seat answered A in 6106681412 (no change in 6a). The confirm went to decision card #22801, ruled A (6108478638), and stage U2 builds it._

Measured on a real showcase boot of this head, with the app default CLI-wired:

- `showcase_member_default` is a **pending** `everyone` suggestion.
- The database holds no `everyone` row and no junction row.
- `confirmAudienceBindingSuggestion` needs the `everyone` row, so a confirm on a fresh database answers `SuggestionStateError` ("not seeded yet").

On `main`, by reading the code (this before-leg was NOT MEASURED in that wiring):

- the boot's junction row made the reconcile record the suggestion as `confirmed` (observed);
- a confirm of any other pending suggestion wrote a junction row that grants nothing.

In the default wiring both trees measured `pending`. This is the suggestion-confirm path that release-cut condition (d) of the stage-1 ACCEPT already holds out of every release. No fix is built here (only delete; U2 belongs to its own stage). The report on #15204 carries the options.

## Acceptance notes

- Four test comments still describe rows the retired seeder wrote: `driver-sql` `sql-driver-sys-position-organization-unique.test.ts:310`, `bootstrap-platform-admin-seeded-provenance.test.ts:204`, `objects/sys-position.organization-unique.test.ts:44` and `suggested-audience-bindings-install-path.test.ts:139`. Each reads as history of an existing database's rows. Not edited.
- Retired modules are not edited, so their comments still name the deleted seeders: `objects/sys-position.object.ts` (stage 8), `seed-name-lookup.ts` (7a), `bootstrap-declared-permissions.ts` (6b-2) and `position-write-through.ts` (7b).
- `scripts/measure-position-name-fold-census.mjs` still models `bindBaselineToEveryone` as a junction producer. It is a measurement instrument whose question (name-fold vs junction) ADR-0131 retires. Carrier: none.

## Gates

Derived with `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` at head `ac2d982b` (merge base `b7cd1af9df`). Each command was run with its exit code recorded, and the record was reconciled with `--ran`: **105 derived, 104 run, 1 NOT MEASURED, 0 unrun**.

- 104 commands exited 0.
- **NOT MEASURED:** `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` exited 3. A shallow clone cannot reach its pinned fixture commit, as on the sibling stages.

Suites on the merged head `ac2d982b`, each after a dependency-closure build (plugin-auth and the example apps were measured at `68ba543e` and not re-run on `ac2d982b`; CI runs them):

| package | files | tests |
|:--|--:|:--|
| `@objectstack/plugin-security` (typecheck + suite) | 197 | 4,005 passed, 45 skipped |
| `@objectstack/plugin-auth` | 136 | 2,769 passed, 10 skipped |
| `@objectstack/runtime` | 352 | 5,789 passed, 19 skipped |
| `@objectstack/dogfood` | 246 (+1 skipped) | 1,994 passed, 9 skipped |
| example apps: showcase / crm / todo / embed-objectql | 33 / 6 / 7 / 1 | 409 / 46 / 238 / 2 passed |

Before-leg of the deletion: with the deletion in place and only the five importing test files fixed, the full plugin-security suite was red, with 22 failures in 3 files (the boot census, the catalog report's built-in precondition, and the #18535 junction cases). The first dogfood run was red too, with 15 failures in 6 files. Every one of them pinned a row the deleted seeders wrote. CI was not awaited.

_Seat edits at landing round 1 (`ac2d982b`, a merge of `main` `b7cd1af9df` plus the census regeneration): the size base, the census figures, the gate head and the suite rows above, from the dev's report 6108751935. Lines 1–2 are unchanged._
